Basketball

11 Apr 25 An 91-87 victory for FC Barcelona against Bologna at the Palau sees them finish the regular season in the Euroleague in fifth place and lines up a tie against Monaco in the first round of the play offs. The blaugranes dominated the match against the Italians but were almost caught out by a fourth quarter surge from Bologna. ... Barça started motivated in the Palau and there were soon 5-0 up in the contest thanks to Justin Anderson. Bologna ... In the second half Punter, Satoransky and Vesely combined to keep Barça in front. The Italians brought themselves to ... However, in the final quarter Bologna came to turn the score around and lead 78-76 with just six minutes remaining. The Palau crowd launched into action and spurred the blaugranes on to a valuable 91-87 win and a quarter final play off against Monaco. - Culers
